title: 2002 AMC 8 Problem 7
statement: The students in Mrs. Sawyer’s class were asked to do a taste test of five kinds of candy. Each student chose one kind of candy. A bar graph of their preferences is shown. What percent of her class chose candy \(E?\)

solutions.text:
There are a total of \[ 6 + 8 + 4 + 2 + 5 = 25 \] students in the class. The percent that chose \(E\) is \[ 100 \cdot \dfrac{5}{25} = \dfrac{100}{5} = 20 \%. \]

Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: Add the heights of all five bars to get the class size.
Compare the height of bar \(E\) with the total number of students.
